projections.source_time_basis: HYCOM instantaneous2022January/July15T00Z;not monthly means or seasonal envelopes.
projections.projection_gate: Interior full-section surface-connected integral maximum and resolved declared primary lower contour;selected model columns do not independently validate named-current axes.
projections.branch_scope: Partial central Caribbean68–80W southern-jet-context reach,with12–16.5N searches. A separate northern jet and its source waters remain outside the intended branch scope; gates can miss northward deflections. Exclude Yucatan,Loop,Antilles and upstream island-passage flows as target identities. Meanders and eddies can dominate geographic maxima; no coherent southern-jet identity or source-water class is independently established. Existing RU29_2024 inversion layers and15cm/s sensitivity remain separate observed/inversion cases, not relabeled as these2022 model snapshots or independently validated by them.
projections.interpolation_assumption: Keep every original fixed-longitude section in declared downstream order. Use selected native model positions;where no column qualifies,use actualnativewrappedlongitude and the declaredlatitude-gate midpoint only as an explicit unresolved reference geometry placeholder with no sampled position or depth. ShortestWGS84legs connect adjacentoriginal references,including across180/-180. Assume linear lowerdepth and paired modelspan only between neighboring original supported nodes;never skip,extrapolate or fill from an alternate cutoff. Distances are reference geometry,not measured current lengths.

projections.branch_scope: Partial subtropical Atlantic35–21W eastward Azores-jet-context reach,with31.5–36.5N searches. Exclude westward subsurface Azores Countercurrent,northern recirculation,Portugal/Canary continuation and detached eddies as target identities. Broad-gate eastward maxima need not follow one coherent current axis. Source24.5W_2009 density-layer extent around2000m is not a uniform bottom or a bound imposed on these2022 model layers. Published mean geostrophic speeds and thermal fronts are not instantaneous threshold limits or depth errors.
